theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 35 群

items.colloc: consumer goods 消費品 | defective goods 瑕疵品
items.distinct: merchandise 商品（不可數） | cargo 貨物（運輸用）
ex: The company will ship the goods next week.
公司下週將運送這批貨物。
Our store offers a wide range of goods.
我們的商店提供各式各樣的商品。
Customs officials inspected the imported goods.
海關官員檢查了進口的貨物。

items.pos: v. 統治；管理（governed 為 govern 的過去式或過去分詞）
items.colloc: strictly governed 被嚴格管理 | be governed by 受...支配
items.distinct: rule 統治（強調權力） | manage 管理（強調事務）
ex: These policies are governed by international law.
這些政策受國際法規範。
The region was governed by a local council.
該地區由地方議會治理。
Market prices are governed by supply and demand.
市場價格受供需機制約束。

items.colloc: government official 政府官員 | local government 地方政府
items.distinct: administration 行政機關 | regime 政權
ex: The government announced new tax regulations today.
政府今日宣布了新的稅務法規。
Many government projects rely on private funding.
許多政府計畫仰賴私人資金。
He works for a local government agency.
他在一家地方政府機構工作。

items.pos: v. 抓取；佔用 | n. 抓取
items.colloc: grab an opportunity 把握機會 | grab a seat 搶位子
items.distinct: seize 奪取（強行） | grasp 緊握（概念或物體）
ex: Let us grab a coffee before the meeting.
開會前我們先去喝杯咖啡吧。
She managed to grab the last available ticket.
她成功搶到了最後一張票。
The company aims to grab a larger market share.
該公司目標是搶占更大的市場份額。

items.pos: n. 組；群體 | v. 將...分組
items.colloc: focus group 焦點小組 | working group 工作小組
items.distinct: team 團隊（目標一致） | category 類別
ex: Please divide the participants into four groups.
請將與會者分成四個小組。
The marketing group presented their latest proposal.
行銷小組發表了最新的提案。
We should group these tasks by priority level.
我們應該按優先順序將這些工作分類。

items.pos: n. 頭痛；令人頭痛的事
items.colloc: a real headache 一個大麻煩 | suffer a headache 遭受頭痛
items.distinct: nuisance 討厭的人事物 | trouble 困難
ex: Scheduling the meeting became a major headache.
安排會議時間變成一件很頭痛的事。
He took some medicine for his splitting headache.
他服了藥來緩解劇烈的頭痛。
Technical issues are a headache for the IT department.
技術問題對資訊部門來說很棘手。

items.colloc: reach the height 達到高峰 | at a height of 在...高度
items.distinct: altitude 海拔高度 | length 長度
ex: The building reaches a height of fifty meters.
這棟建築物高度達到五十公尺。
Business success was at its height last year.
商業成就去年達到巔峰。
Please check the height requirements for this equipment.
請確認該設備的高度要求。

items.colloc: informal meeting 非正式會議 | informal dress code 非正式穿著
items.distinct: casual 隨便的 | unofficial 非官方的
ex: They held an informal chat during the break.
他們在休息時間進行了非正式閒聊。
The atmosphere at the startup is quite informal.
這家新創公司的氣氛相當隨興。
Please keep the written report professional, not informal.
書面報告請保持專業，不要過於口語。

items.colloc: a brilliant invention 一項絕妙發明 | patent an invention 為發明申請專利
items.distinct: discovery 發現（既有事物） | innovation 創新（改進）
ex: The invention of the internet changed the business world.
網際網路的發明改變了商業世界。
She is working on a new invention for the home.
她正在研發一種新的居家發明。
The company invested heavily in this invention.
該公司對這項發明進行了鉅額投資。

items.pos: v. 邀請；招致 | n. 邀請
items.colloc: invite someone to 邀請某人至 | send an invite 發送邀請
items.distinct: ask 詢問/要求 | request 正式要求
ex: I would like to invite you to our gala.
我想邀請您參加我們的盛會。
Their low prices invite more customers to visit.
他們低廉的價格吸引更多顧客上門。
Did you receive the invite for the annual dinner?
你有收到年度晚宴的邀請函嗎？

items.pos: adj. 共同的；聯合的 | n. 關節
items.colloc: joint venture 合資企業 | joint account 聯名帳戶
items.distinct: shared 共享的 | mutual 互相的
ex: The two companies formed a joint venture.
這兩家公司成立了一家合資企業。
This is a joint effort to increase sales.
這是提高銷售額的共同努力。
We will make a joint decision later today.
我們稍後會做出共同決策。

items.colloc: sharp knife 利刃 | kitchen knife 菜刀
items.distinct: blade 刀片 | cutter 切割器
ex: Please handle the knife with great care.
請務必小心使用這把刀。
The chef uses a professional knife for cooking.
主廚使用專業的刀具烹飪。
He sharpened the knife before cutting the meat.
他在切肉前磨了磨刀子。

items.pos: n. 風景；景觀 | v. 對...進行景觀設計
items.colloc: competitive landscape 競爭態勢 | beautiful landscape 美麗風景
items.distinct: scenery 風景（自然） | view 視野
ex: The competitive landscape of this industry is changing.
這個產業的競爭態勢正在改變。
They hired a firm to landscape the garden.
他們聘請了一家公司來進行花園造景。
The view features a stunning mountain landscape.
該視野擁有迷人的山區景觀。

items.colloc: large scale 大規模 | large amount 大量
items.distinct: big 大的（廣義） | huge 巨大的
ex: We are planning a large event for our clients.
我們正在為客戶規劃一場大型活動。
A large portion of the budget goes to marketing.
預算中很大一部分用於行銷。
The company has a large number of employees.
這家公司擁有大量員工。

items.pos: n. 水準；等級；高度 | adj. 水平的
items.colloc: at an entry level 入門級 | skill level 技能水準
items.distinct: rank 等級/職位 | stage 階段
ex: Your language skill level is quite impressive.
您的語言能力水準令人印象深刻。
The project reached a new level of success.
該專案達到了新的成功水準。
Please ensure the surface is perfectly level.
請確保表面完全水平。

items.colloc: loose ends 未完之事 | loose clothing 寬鬆衣物
items.distinct: lost 遺失的 | release 釋放
ex: The screw has become loose over time.
螺絲隨著時間推移變得鬆動了。
He prefers wearing loose shirts in summer.
他夏天偏好穿寬鬆的襯衫。
There are still some loose ends in the contract.
合約中仍有一些未解決的細節。

items.colloc: business magazine 商業雜誌 | monthly magazine 月刊
items.distinct: journal 學術期刊 | newspaper 報紙
ex: We placed an advertisement in the business magazine.
我們在商業雜誌上刊登了廣告。
She contributes articles to a fashion magazine.
她為時尚雜誌撰寫文章。
You can find the report in this month's magazine.
你可以在本月的雜誌中找到該報告。

items.colloc: the true meaning 真義 | clear meaning 明確的含義
items.distinct: definition 定義 | significance 重要性
ex: What is the exact meaning of this clause?
這項條款的確切含義是什麼？
His words carry a deeper meaning than expected.
他的話語包含比預期更深層的意義。
The meaning of the feedback is quite clear.
這項回饋的用意十分明確。

items.colloc: around midday 在中午左右 | midday sun 正午的太陽
items.distinct: noon 正午 | midnight 午夜
ex: The meeting will conclude around midday.
會議將在中午左右結束。
It gets very hot during the midday heat.
正午時分天氣變得非常炎熱。
Let's schedule a lunch break at midday.
我們安排在中午休息用餐吧。

items.pos: n. 最小值；最低限度 | adj. 最低的
items.colloc: minimum wage 最低工資 | minimum requirement 最低要求
items.distinct: minimal 最小的（形容詞） | maximum 最大值
ex: The minimum requirement for this job is experience.
這份工作的最低要求是具備經驗。
We need a minimum of ten people to start.
我們至少需要十個人才能開始。
The company raised the minimum wage last month.
公司上個月提高了最低工資。
